game.title: DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin

roadmap.title: New Game — protect quests, recruit Majula, and clear the four Great Souls
roadmap.description: Keep Steam connected, reach 8 Intelligence and 8 Faith when merchants require them, recruit all seven Majula settlers before confronting Licia, record every gesture and covenant prompt, summon Lucatiel and Benhart whenever available, and preserve every Soul of a Giant while clearing the four Primal Bonfires and Drangleic Castle.

roadmap.title: Late New Game and NG+ — finish NPC routes, memories, covenants, and DLC spells
roadmap.description: Obtain the King's Ring and Ashen Mist Heart, finish the giant memories and Throne of Want, collect every DLC spell, complete Pilgrims of Dark, close Lucatiel and Benhart only after three surviving boss wins, defeat Vendrick while holding Souls of a Giant, and use NG+ for any missed NPC or intensity-2 boss-soul spell.

roadmap.title: NG++ — reach Chancellor Wellager and finish the spell sets
roadmap.description: Enter a true third cycle, open the Shrine of Winter by defeating the four Great Souls or earning 3,000,000 souls during NG++, reach Drangleic Castle, buy Bountiful Sunlight, Wrath of the Gods, and Great Chaos Fireball from Chancellor Wellager, and confirm all 31 sorceries, 28 miracles, 24 pyromancies, and 23 hexes on the same character.

achievements.description: Earn all achievements
achievements.sortReason: Final meta unlock after every other achievement.
achievements.summary: Unlock the other 37 achievements for Steam app 335300 on the same profile.

guide.context: Every individual unlock must register before this meta achievement can trigger, so keep the Steam client online when completing achievement conditions.

steps.text: Complete every other achievement in the 38-achievement Steam list and confirm that each one appears as unlocked.
Complete whichever achievement remains last; @mechanic{The Dark Soul} should register with that final unlock.

achievements.description: Reclaim flesh and set out as an Undead
achievements.summary: Finish character creation with the three Fire Keepers in @loc{Things Betwixt} and leave the dwelling as an Undead.

guide.context: This mandatory opening sequence occurs before Majula, and the selected class does not change the achievement route.

steps.text: Enter the @loc{Fire Keepers’ Dwelling} in Things Betwixt and speak with the three elderly Fire Keepers.
Name and create the character, confirm the choices, and finish the conversation that restores human form.

achievements.description: Acquire the King’s Ring from the Undead Crypt.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Velstadt} in the @loc{Undead Crypt} and take the @item{King’s Ring} from the corpse in Vendrick’s chamber.

guide.context: Vendrick remains passive when the ring is collected; attacking and defeating @enemy{Vendrick} is a separate requirement that can be completed later.

steps.text: Reach the end of the Undead Crypt and defeat @enemy{Velstadt, the Royal Aegis}.
Enter Vendrick’s chamber and pick up the @item{King’s Ring} from the corpse at the far end.

achievements.description: Receive the Ashen Mist Heart from the Ancient Dragon.
achievements.summary: Reach the summit of @loc{Dragon Shrine}, speak to the @npc{Ancient Dragon}, and accept the @item{Ashen Mist Heart}.

guide.context: The Ashen Mist Heart opens the giant memories and lights one of Cale’s eight map flames; killing the Ancient Dragon is unnecessary.

steps.text: Use the King’s Ring route through Aldia’s Keep and Dragon Aerie to reach the Ancient Dragon at the top of Dragon Shrine.
Speak to the @npc{Ancient Dragon} and accept the @item{Ashen Mist Heart} without attacking it.

achievements.description: Complete an ending after the Throne of Want battles.
achievements.summary: Use the Giant’s Kinship to enter the @loc{Throne of Want}, defeat Throne Watcher, Throne Defender, and Nashandra, then choose either ending.

guide.context: Defeating Vendrick before Nashandra can add Aldia and the walk-away choice, but either available ending unlocks the achievement.

steps.text: Enter @loc{Memory of Jeigh} with the Ashen Mist Heart, defeat the @enemy{Giant Lord}, and receive the @item{Giant’s Kinship}.
Enter the Throne of Want and defeat @enemy{Throne Watcher}, @enemy{Throne Defender}, and @enemy{Nashandra}; defeat Aldia too if that encounter appears.
Approach or leave the Throne of Want when prompted and complete either ending sequence.

achievements.description: Defeat the Last Giant in the Forest of Fallen Giants.
achievements.summary: Reach the lowest chamber of the @loc{Forest of Fallen Giants} fortress and defeat the @enemy{Last Giant}.

guide.context: This victory advances Merchant Hag Melentia and Cale toward Majula and lights the first flame on Cale’s basement map.

steps.text: After finding the Soldier Key, unlock the fortress route that descends to the Last Giant’s arena in @loc{Forest of Fallen Giants}.
Defeat the @enemy{Last Giant} to receive its soul and the achievement.

achievements.description: Light the Primal Bonfire after defeating the Lost Sinner.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Lost Sinner} in @loc{Sinner’s Rise} and light the Primal Bonfire beyond the arena.

guide.context: Lighting this bonfire records the Lost Sinner event on Cale’s map; torches in the side rooms make the boss arena bright enough to lock on.

steps.text: Cross Sinner’s Rise, enter the flooded prison arena, and defeat the @enemy{Lost Sinner}.
Enter the chamber beyond the boss arena and light the @mechanic{Primal Bonfire}.

achievements.description: Light the Primal Bonfire after defeating the Old Iron King.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Old Iron King} at the end of @loc{Iron Keep} and light the Primal Bonfire beyond the arena.

guide.context: The Old Iron King victory supplies one of the four Great Souls and lights a required flame on Cale’s Majula map.

steps.text: Traverse Iron Keep and defeat the @enemy{Old Iron King} in the lava arena.
Enter the small chamber beyond the arena and light the @mechanic{Primal Bonfire}.

achievements.description: Light the Primal Bonfire after defeating The Rotten.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{The Rotten} at the end of @loc{Black Gulch} and light the Primal Bonfire beyond the arena.

guide.context: The Rotten can later be revived with Bonfire Ascetics for NG++ soul farming; the first victory also lights one of Cale’s map flames.

steps.text: Cross Black Gulch, enter the final arena, and defeat @enemy{The Rotten}.
Enter the chamber beyond The Rotten’s arena and light the @mechanic{Primal Bonfire}.

achievements.description: Light the Primal Bonfire after defeating the Duke’s Dear Freja.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Duke’s Dear Freja}, collect the arena’s Great Soul, and light the @loc{Brightstone Cove Tseldora} Primal Bonfire.

guide.context: The Great Soul appears as a red orb on the arena floor rather than entering the inventory automatically; the victory also advances Cale’s map.

steps.text: Reach the lower Brightstone Cove chapel and defeat the @enemy{Duke’s Dear Freja}.
Pick up the red Great Soul orb from the floor of Freja’s arena.
Pass through the Hollowed Duke’s room and light the @mechanic{Primal Bonfire} beyond it.

achievements.description: Defeat the Looking Glass Knight in Drangleic Castle.
achievements.summary: Open the rain-soaked @loc{King’s Passage} in Drangleic Castle and defeat the @enemy{Looking Glass Knight}.

guide.context: Benhart’s summon sign appears before this fog gate after his earlier conversations, making the fight one opportunity toward Moonlight Greatsword.

steps.text: Progress through Drangleic Castle until the elevator route opens the @loc{King’s Passage}.
Cross the passage, enter the fog gate, and defeat the @enemy{Looking Glass Knight}.

achievements.description: Defeat Vendrick in the Undead Crypt.
achievements.summary: Hold at least four @item{Souls of a Giant}, awaken Vendrick in the @loc{Undead Crypt}, and defeat the former king.

guide.context: Vendrick’s defense falls for each Soul of a Giant held, with five giving the practical minimum defense; consuming the souls makes the fight much harder.

steps.text: Collect four or preferably five @item{Souls of a Giant} from the giant memories, the Black Gulch giants, and optionally the Ancient Dragon, and keep them in the inventory.
Return to Vendrick’s chamber behind Velstadt and strike the wandering king until the boss fight begins.
Defeat @enemy{Vendrick} while the Souls of a Giant remain in the inventory.

achievements.description: Reinforce a weapon to its limit
achievements.summary: Use a blacksmith to reinforce one normal weapon to @mechanic{+10} with a Titanite Slab.

guide.context: A normal +10 path consumes six Titanite Shards, six Large Titanite Shards, six Titanite Chunks, and one Titanite Slab.

steps.text: Choose a normal weapon that follows the standard Titanite reinforcement path and bring it to a blacksmith.
Spend the required Titanite and souls to reinforce the weapon through @mechanic{+10}, using a @item{Titanite Slab} for the final level.

achievements.description: Learn all gestures
achievements.sortReason: Track every NPC gesture before advancing their quest or killing them.
achievements.summary: Learn all 20 gestures on one character, including the eight starting gestures and 12 taught by NPCs or covenants.

guide.context: Several teachers move or depend on quest state, so learn each gesture during its first available cycle and do not kill the NPC beforehand.

collectibles.method: Speak to @npc{Felkin the Outcast} with 8 Intelligence and 8 Faith and buy Resonant Weapon.

collectibles.name: Scraps of Life
collectibles.method: Reach @npc{Cromwell the Pardoner} above the chapel and buy Scraps of Life.

collectibles.name: Twisted Barricade
collectibles.method: Climb the ladders in Doors of Pharros and loot the corpse at the top.

collectibles.name: Whisper of Despair
collectibles.method: Use a Pharros’ Lockstone on the floor contraption facing the raised bridge, cross the lowered bridge, and loot the corpse.

achievements.description: Discover the Heirs of the Sun covenant in Harvest Valley.
achievements.summary: Examine the broken sunlight statue on Harvest Valley’s side path and reach the @mechanic{Heirs of the Sun} joining prompt.

guide.context: Joining is optional for the discovery unlock, but rank 3 and 30 Sunlight Medals are later required for Sunlight Spear.

steps.text: In @loc{Harvest Valley}, turn left before the Earthen Peak entrance and follow the path beyond the poison-pool enemies.
Examine the broken sunlight statue and continue until the game asks whether to join the @mechanic{Heirs of the Sun}.

achievements.description: Discover the Blue Sentinels covenant in the Cathedral of Blue.
achievements.summary: Carry a @item{Token of Fidelity} to @npc{Blue Sentinel Targray} after Old Dragonslayer and reach the Blue Sentinels joining prompt.

guide.context: A normal white-phantom boss victory grants a Token of Fidelity, and a fixed token also lies on the outcrop near Huntsman’s Copse’s second bonfire.

steps.text: Earn a @item{Token of Fidelity} from a successful normal white-phantom boss assist or collect the Huntsman’s Copse token.
Defeat the @enemy{Old Dragonslayer} and enter the @loc{Cathedral of Blue}.
Speak to @npc{Blue Sentinel Targray} while carrying the token and continue until he offers the @mechanic{Blue Sentinels} covenant.

achievements.description: Discover the Brotherhood of Blood covenant in Undead Purgatory.
achievements.summary: Carry a @item{Token of Spite} to @npc{Titchy Gren} after Executioner’s Chariot and reach the Brotherhood of Blood joining prompt.

guide.context: Great Chaos Fireball has a true-NG++ merchant route, so no Brotherhood of Blood PvP ranks are required for the full completion.

steps.text: Earn a @item{Token of Spite} from a successful invasion or collect the fixed token before entering The Gutter.
Defeat the @enemy{Executioner’s Chariot} and enter @loc{Undead Purgatory}.
Speak to @npc{Titchy Gren} while carrying the token, answer his questions Yes, and continue until he offers the @mechanic{Brotherhood of Blood}.

achievements.description: Discover the Way of Blue covenant in Majula.
achievements.summary: Exhaust @npc{Crestfallen Saulden}’s dialogue beside Majula’s monument and reach the @mechanic{Way of Blue} joining prompt.

guide.context: The discovery achievement triggers at the offer, and the same conversation also teaches the Welcome gesture.

steps.text: Find @npc{Crestfallen Saulden} sitting at the base of the monument overlooking the sea in @loc{Majula}.
Continue speaking until Saulden asks whether to join the @mechanic{Way of Blue}; learn Welcome before leaving.

achievements.description: Discover the Rat King Covenant after defeating one of its bosses.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Royal Rat Vanguard} or @enemy{Royal Rat Authority}, speak to the @npc{Rat King}, and reach his covenant joining prompt.

guide.context: Royal Rat Vanguard in Grave of Saints and Royal Rat Authority in Doors of Pharros are interchangeable discovery routes.

steps.text: Choose either route: kill @enemy{Royal Rat Vanguard} beneath the Grave of Saints, or kill @enemy{Royal Rat Authority} inside Doors of Pharros.
Speak to the @npc{Rat King} immediately beyond the chosen arena and continue until he offers the @mechanic{Rat King Covenant}.

achievements.description: Discover the Bell Keepers covenant in either belfry.
achievements.summary: Open @loc{Belfry Luna} or @loc{Belfry Sol}, speak to the Belfry Guard, and reach the @mechanic{Bell Keepers} joining prompt.

guide.context: Bell Keepers rank 2 requires 30 covenant points and awards Hidden Weapon for Master of Sorcery.

steps.text: Spend a Pharros’ Lockstone below the Lost Bastille Servants’ Quarters bonfire to open Belfry Luna, or enter Belfry Sol past Iron Keep’s second bonfire.
Speak to the @npc{Belfry Guard} inside the chosen belfry and continue until the @mechanic{Bell Keepers} joining prompt appears.

achievements.description: Discover the Dragon Remnants covenant by delivering the Petrified Egg.
achievements.summary: Give Dragon Shrine’s @item{Petrified Egg} to @npc{Magerold of Lanafir} and reach the Dragon Remnants joining prompt.

guide.context: The egg is in Dragonfang Villard’s room, so the covenant cannot be offered until the late-game Dragon Shrine route is open.

steps.text: At @loc{Dragon Shrine}, enter the room guarded by @enemy{Dragonfang Villard}, defeat the invader, and collect the @item{Petrified Egg}.
Return to @npc{Magerold of Lanafir} in Iron Keep and give him the Petrified Egg.
Speak to Magerold again and continue until he offers the @mechanic{Dragon Remnants} covenant.

achievements.description: Discover the Company of Champions covenant at the Victor’s Stone.
achievements.summary: Examine Majula’s @loc{Victor’s Stone}, accept both warnings, and reach the @mechanic{Company of Champions} joining prompt.

guide.context: Remaining in this covenant strengthens enemies, disables friendly summons, and prevents normal enemy despawning, so leave after the discovery unless those effects are wanted.

steps.text: From @loc{Majula}, follow the cliff path right of the passage toward Heide’s Tower of Flame until reaching the Victor’s Stone.
Examine the stone, answer Yes to both warnings, and continue until the game asks whether to join the @mechanic{Company of Champions}.

achievements.description: Discover the Pilgrims of Dark covenant after three meetings with Grandahl.
achievements.summary: Locate @npc{Darkdiver Grandahl} three times—below Shaded Woods, beneath Black Gulch, and under Drangleic Castle—then reach his covenant offer.

guide.context: All three meetings are also required to open the Dark Chasms, buy Grandahl’s hexes, and reach covenant rank 3 for Climax.

steps.text: Beyond the two Shaded Woods towers, circle toward the lone cliff tree, drop into the hidden pit, and speak to @npc{Darkdiver Grandahl}.
In Black Gulch, descend the ledges between the two giant worms, obtain the @item{Forgotten Key} from the giants below, unlock Grandahl’s door, and speak to him.
Near Drangleic Castle’s first bonfire, feed a Stone Soldier soul to the door farthest left; cross the room’s weak floor, light the bonfire below, and speak to Grandahl.
After the third meeting, continue the conversation until Grandahl offers the @mechanic{Pilgrims of Dark} covenant.

achievements.description: Max-out devotion to covenant
achievements.summary: Join @mechanic{Pilgrims of Dark}, clear all three Dark Chasms of Old, defeat @enemy{Darklurker}, and claim covenant rank 3.

guide.context: This route also supplies Climax and Lifedrain Patch for Master of Hexes, so it avoids a separate covenant grind.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Darkdiver Grandahl} in all three locations and join the @mechanic{Pilgrims of Dark}.
Give Grandahl one Human Effigy at each portal, clear all three @loc{Dark Chasms of Old}, light every chasm’s brazier, and leave through the exit fog.
After the third cleared chasm, defeat @enemy{Darklurker}.
Speak to Grandahl after the victory and receive the rank-3 reward and achievement.

achievements.description: Complete the eight events represented on Cale’s Majula map.
achievements.summary: Light all eight flames on Cale’s @loc{Majula mansion} map, then talk to @npc{Cale} until he gives his equipment.

guide.context: Cale moves into the mansion basement only after his Forest dialogue, the Last Giant victory, the mansion door opening, and the basement skeleton’s defeat.

collectibles.name: Last Giant flame
collectibles.method: Defeat the @enemy{Last Giant}.

collectibles.name: Lost Sinner flame
collectibles.method: Defeat the @enemy{Lost Sinner}.

collectibles.name: Old Iron King flame
collectibles.method: Defeat the @enemy{Old Iron King}.

collectibles.name: Duke’s Dear Freja flame
collectibles.method: Defeat the @enemy{Duke’s Dear Freja} and collect the Great Soul orb in the arena.

collectibles.name: The Rotten flame
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{The Rotten}.

collectibles.name: King’s Ring flame
collectibles.method: Defeat Velstadt and collect the @item{King’s Ring} from Vendrick’s chamber.

collectibles.name: Ashen Mist Heart flame
collectibles.method: Speak to the @npc{Ancient Dragon} and accept the @item{Ashen Mist Heart}.

collectibles.name: Throne defenders flame
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Throne Watcher} and @enemy{Throne Defender}.

achievements.description: Give Rosabeth of Melfia something to wear.
achievements.summary: Unpetrify @npc{Rosabeth of Melfia} on the Majula–Shaded Woods path and give her any wearable armor piece.

guide.context: Clothing Rosabeth also lets her move to Majula, where she counts toward Gathering of Exiles and sells the basic pyromancies.

steps.text: Use a @item{Fragrant Branch of Yore} on the petrified @npc{Rosabeth of Melfia} beside the lever between Majula and Shaded Woods.
Speak to Rosabeth, choose the equipment-gift option, and give her any wearable armor piece.

achievements.description: Bring all seven required settlers to Majula.
achievements.sortReason: Recruit all seven settlers before using the Crushed Eye Orb against Licia.
achievements.summary: Move Cale, Carhillion, Gilligan, Licia, Melentia, Rosabeth, and Chloanne to @loc{Majula} while all seven remain alive.

guide.context: A gravestone does not count as Licia’s presence, so finish this achievement before using the Crushed Eye Orb against her for Soothing Sunlight.

collectibles.name: Cale the Cartographer
collectibles.method: Exhaust Cale’s cave dialogue, defeat the Last Giant, open the Majula mansion, kill its basement skeleton, and rest until Cale appears beside the map.

collectibles.name: Carhillion of the Fold
collectibles.method: Speak to Carhillion near the ship with at least 8 Intelligence, defeat the Flexile Sentry, and rest until he moves to Majula.

collectibles.name: Laddersmith Gilligan
collectibles.method: Defeat @enemy{Mytha, the Baneful Queen}; Gilligan then moves to Majula automatically.

collectibles.name: Licia of Lindeldt
collectibles.method: After Dragonrider, exhaust Licia’s dialogue beside the second bonfire and rest until she moves to Majula’s Rotunda.

collectibles.name: Merchant Hag Melentia
collectibles.method: Exhaust Melentia’s dialogue, defeat the Last Giant, and rest until she moves to Majula.

collectibles.name: Rosabeth of Melfia
collectibles.method: Unpetrify Rosabeth with a Fragrant Branch of Yore, give her wearable armor, and rest until she moves to Majula.

collectibles.name: Stone Trader Chloanne
collectibles.method: Exhaust Chloanne’s dialogue near the first bonfire and rest until she moves to Majula.

achievements.description: Inherit Benhart of Jugo's equipment
achievements.sortReason: Accumulate three surviving Benhart boss victories before his final Memory of Orro dialogue.
achievements.summary: Keep @npc{Benhart of Jugo} alive through three summoned boss victories, then exhaust his dialogue in @loc{Memory of Orro}.

guide.context: Valid victories include Prowling Magus, Looking Glass Knight, Giant Lord, Elana, and the Throne of Want bosses—Throne Watcher, Throne Defender, and Nashandra; Benhart must still be alive when a qualifying victory completes for that fight to add one credit.

steps.text: Exhaust Benhart’s dialogue on the Majula–Shaded Woods path after freeing Rosabeth, at Drangleic Castle’s Central Castle bonfire, outside Memory of Orro, and inside @loc{Memory of Orro}.
Summon Benhart for three qualifying boss fights and keep him alive until each boss dies.
For the Giant Lord opportunity, summon Benhart rather than Captain Drummond because their signs cannot be active together.
After three surviving victories, return to @loc{Memory of Orro} and exhaust Benhart’s dialogue until he gives his equipment.

achievements.description: Receive Captain Drummond’s equipment after defeating the Giant Lord.
achievements.summary: Defeat the @enemy{Giant Lord}, return to @npc{Captain Drummond} in @loc{Memory of Vammar}, and receive the Drangleic Helm.

guide.context: Drummond does not need to survive or even enter the Giant Lord fight, leaving Benhart available for that summon opportunity.

steps.text: Use the Ashen Mist Heart on the withered tree near Pate’s former Forest of Fallen Giants position, enter @loc{Memory of Vammar}, and exhaust Captain Drummond’s dialogue.
Enter @loc{Memory of Jeigh} and defeat the @enemy{Giant Lord}; summoning Drummond is unnecessary.
Return to Memory of Vammar and speak to @npc{Captain Drummond} until he gives the @item{Drangleic Helm}.

achievements.description: Receive Lucatiel of Mirrah’s equipment after three surviving summon victories.
achievements.sortReason: Accumulate three surviving Lucatiel boss victories before speaking to her at Aldia's Keep.
achievements.summary: Keep @npc{Lucatiel of Mirrah} alive through three summoned boss victories, then exhaust her dialogue at @loc{Aldia’s Keep}.

guide.context: Bonfire Ascetics can revive a qualifying boss, but they cannot reset Lucatiel’s story after the final Aldia’s Keep conversation.

steps.text: Exhaust Lucatiel’s dialogue in No-Man’s Wharf, Lost Bastille, Earthen Peak, and Black Gulch before speaking to her at the @loc{Aldia’s Keep} Foregarden shack for the final conversation.
Summon Lucatiel for three fights chosen from Flexile Sentry, Lost Sinner, Smelter Demon, The Rotten, and Burnt Ivory King, and keep her alive until each boss dies.
If Lucatiel dies during a qualifying attempt, die or leave before killing the boss, then summon her and retry.
After three surviving victories, find Lucatiel in the Foregarden shack at Aldia’s Keep and exhaust her dialogue until she gives her equipment.

achievements.description: Inherit Steady Hand McDuff’s equipment after using his smithing services.
achievements.summary: Spend at least 14,000 souls on @npc{Steady Hand McDuff}’s reinforcement or infusion services, then talk to him for his gift.

guide.context: McDuff must receive the Dull Ember and leave the chest before his full services and reward dialogue become available; ordinary shop purchases do not count toward the threshold.

steps.text: Enter McDuff’s Lost Bastille workshop, light the room’s sconce with a torch, and rest at the bonfire so he moves away from the chest.
Collect the @item{Dull Ember} from the Tower Apart chest and give it to @npc{Steady Hand McDuff}.
Spend at least 14,000 souls with McDuff specifically on weapon reinforcement and infusion services.
Choose Talk until McDuff gives a @item{Titanite Slab} and the achievement.

achievements.description: Inherit Laddersmith Gilligan’s equipment after buying his largest ladder.
achievements.summary: Buy @npc{Laddersmith Gilligan}’s 12,000-soul Majula ladder, then talk to him until he gives the Melu Scimitar.

guide.context: Gilligan moves to Majula after Mytha dies even if his Earthen Peak ledge was missed, and only the largest ladder is required for the reward.

steps.text: Defeat @enemy{Mytha, the Baneful Queen}, then find @npc{Laddersmith Gilligan} beside the Majula pit.
Select Gilligan’s 12,000-soul ladder and confirm the purchase.
Choose Talk until Gilligan gives the @item{Melu Scimitar} and the achievement.

achievements.description: Inherit Vengarl’s equipment from his severed head in Shaded Woods.
achievements.summary: Find @npc{Vengarl’s Head} in the misty @loc{Shaded Woods} clearing and exhaust his dialogue until he gives Vengarl’s Helm.

guide.context: The same conversation teaches the Decapitate gesture, so complete both rewards before leaving the clearing.

steps.text: From the Shaded Woods fog area, follow the boundary to the clearing containing @npc{Vengarl’s Head}.
Repeatedly choose Talk, learn @mechanic{Decapitate}, and continue until Vengarl gives @item{Vengarl’s Helm}.

achievements.description: Die for the first time
achievements.summary: Let the player character die once from any enemy, hazard, fall, or other lethal damage.

guide.context: The first death is sufficient; recovering the dropped souls afterward is unrelated to the unlock.

steps.text: Allow any enemy or environmental hazard to reduce the character’s health to zero and complete the death animation once.
